title: SDLC Config
description: Validates .sdlc-v2/config.json — unified project-level configuration for sdlc-plugin skills.

versionSection.description: Controls the version skill's behaviour via three independently toggleable release paths — tag, versionFile, changelog — that share only bump policy (preRelease, preReleasePolicy) and delivery method. Each path is enabled or disabled explicitly; a missing sub-object means that path is disabled. This is a breaking config shape: the old flat shape (top-level "mode", string "versionFile", "changelogMethod"/"changelog" boolean, "rcAutoContinue" boolean) is rejected outright. Run /setup --only version to migrate.

preRelease.description: Default pre-release label applied when no explicit base bump or --pre is given.

preReleasePolicy.description: Whether version_prepare suggests a release-candidate build instead of a final release when the caller hasn't said otherwise. Defaults to "continue-rc".

method.description: How the versionFile and changelog paths deliver their writes when enabled: "push" (default) commits and pushes directly to main; "pr" opens a release PR instead.

tag.description: The tag release path: creating a git tag (and GitHub Release) on version bump.

enabled.description: Whether the tag path is active.

prefix.description: Prefix prepended to the tag name (e.g. "v").

versionFile.description: The version-file release path: writing the bumped version into a tracked file.

enabled.description: Whether the versionFile path is active.

path.description: Path to the file that stores the version number, relative to the main worktree root.

changelog.description: The changelog release path: prepending a release entry to a changelog file.

enabled.description: Whether the changelog path is active.

file.description: Path to the changelog file. Defaults to "CHANGELOG.md" when enabled and unset.

defaultProject.description: Default Jira project key (2–10 uppercase letters).

projects.description: Allowed Jira project keys when the repo maps to multiple projects. When set, jira validates --project arguments and presents a closed-list prompt on fallback.

subjectPattern.description: Regex pattern the commit subject line must match.

subjectPatternError.description: Human-readable error message when subject pattern fails.

requireBodyFor.description: Commit types that require a body message.

requiredTrailers.description: Required trailer keys in commit message.

prLabelsSection.description: Configures how /pr chooses labels (issue #197). Mode `off` (default) adds no labels except those forced via --label. Mode `rules` evaluates user-defined deterministic rules. Mode `llm` lets the LLM pick labels via fuzzy matching against repo labels (legacy behavior, opt-in only).

mode.description: Label selection mode. `off` = no automatic labels (forced labels still apply). `rules` = evaluate user-defined rules deterministically. `llm` = legacy LLM fuzzy match.

rules.description: Label rules evaluated when mode = `rules`. Each rule names exactly one target label and one signal type in `when`. Multiple rules may target the same label (OR semantics).

label.description: Repo label to apply when this rule matches. Must exist in the repository's label list.

when.description: Signal that triggers this rule. Exactly one signal type per rule.

branchPrefix.description: Match if currentBranch starts with any listed prefix (e.g. "fix/", "feat/").

commitType.description: Match if any commit subject begins with `<type>:` or `<type>(scope):` (e.g. "feat", "fix").

pathGlob.description: Match if every changed file matches one of the listed globs (e.g. "**/*.md").

jiraType.description: Match if jiraTicket.type is in the list (e.g. "Bug", "Story").

diffSizeUnder.description: Match if diffStat.totalLinesChanged is strictly less than this value.

prSection.description: Controls pull request title validation and label assignment.

titlePattern.description: Regex pattern the PR title must match.

titlePatternError.description: Human-readable error message when title pattern fails.

expectedAccount.description: Expected gh account login for PR creation. Cascades to git remote origin owner if unset.

severity.description: error = blocking; warning = advisory. Defaults to error when omitted.

planSection.description: Controls plan behavior and custom guardrails.

guardrails.description: Custom guardrails evaluated during plan critique phases.

tasks.description: Team contract for plan tasks and deliverables.

requiredFields.description: Required fields for each task in a plan.

contractShape.description: Shape of the task contract: full (complete), minimal (essential), or none (flexible).

executeSection.description: Controls execute-plan behavior and runtime guardrails.

guardrails.description: Custom guardrails evaluated during execute-plan runtime (pre-wave and post-wave checks).

commitWaves.description: Whether execute_state's wave-commit action stages and commits each completed wave's changes itself (git add -A + git commit). When false, wave-commit does not touch git and instead returns an instruction to commit the wave manually and record the sha via wave-committed.

planStyleSection.description: Configures personal plan style preferences (verbosity, audience, narrative rules).

verbosity.description: Plan verbosity level: terse (minimal), standard (balanced), or detailed (comprehensive).

audience.description: Target audience for the plan narrative.

narrativeRules.description: Custom narrative rules to apply when generating plans.
